notes_for_editor: Thin record: one Forest Lookouts page (a single 1986 visit note), a Mapcarta place entry for the point's elevation and county, and the July 2026 standing-lookout list. The Forest Lookouts page is the only source describing the tower. No NHLR or FFLOS Oregon entry under this name appears in the local crawl cache. Davis Point towers in Idaho and Montana (firelookout.com /id/ and /mt/, and data/towers/id and data/towers/mt) are different lookouts and were not used. Whether any structure remains was not checked on the ground. The record's coordinates were not checked against a source.
